name: final
philosophy: Havelock-first shape. It is forced by three verified facts: (1) the last Sunday nonstop leaves 13:35 and the budget makes the Rs 9,206 Akasa 10:35 the only sane return, so Sunday must be empty; (2) Baratang needs a full Port-Blair day ending ~15:00, and Munda Pahad's trek gate shuts at 15:00, so both anchor to Fri/Sat; (3) Bharatpur watersports need the 14:32 Thursday high tide and Natural Bridge needs the 08:51 Friday low. Sleep averages 7.3 h/night (min 5.75). Cost ~Rs 40,400/person - the user's worst-case line - with listed swaps down to ~Rs 37k.
risks: September is peak monsoon (388 mm avg): every ferry/boat can be weather-delayed - all bookings chosen refundable where possible (Green Ocean/Makruzz tickets are not; budget assumes they sail)
Ferry prices/times captured live 2026-08-19; rebook-check all four sailings when booking
Bhuma homestay is cash-only and non-refundable (Rs 5,000 damage deposit)
Baratang cab price is an operator-range estimate (Rs 6,500-9,000 private for 3) - lock by phone a day ahead
Bioluminescence released by user: full moon Sep 26 kills it; optional Thu 03:30 attempt only if operator confirms (unlikely in full-moon week)

days.title: WHEELS UP → SWARAJ DWEEP
days.theme: Chennai dawn flight, island-hop by catamaran, first sunset at Asia's best beach.

events.title: Wake up & roll out (Chennai)
events.notes: Bags packed night before. Keep each check-in bag <=15 kg (Akasa free allowance; Nautika ferry also caps 15 kg).
events.tips: Carry printed ferry tickets + DL photocopies for scooter rentals.

events.title: Ride to Chennai Airport T1
events.notes: Own cab/Uber (~Rs 700, outside trip budget).

events.title: Check-in + security (Akasa)
events.notes: Akasa bag-drop closes 06:55; buffer built in.

events.title: FLY — Akasa QP 1145 to Port Blair
events.notes: Boeing 737 MAX 8, 2h15m over the Bay of Bengal. Window seats left side for the island approach.

events.title: Cab toward town (Junglighat)
events.notes: Icy Spicy is en route between airport and jetty.

events.title: Veg lunch @ Icy Spicy
events.notes: Port Blair's top pure-veg (4.2, 3.5k reviews).

events.title: Green Ocean check-in
events.notes: Counter opens 60 min before sailing; PRINTED ticket mandatory on Green Ocean.
events.tips: Print tickets in Chennai or at a shop near the jetty.

events.title: SAIL — Green Ocean 1 to Havelock
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 1,400 all-in (Rs 1,050 + Rs 50 PMB + Rs 300 fuel)
events.notes: Cheapest verified sailing of the day. Motion-sickness tab 30 min before if the sea is up.

events.title: Scooters at the jetty → ride out
events.cost_note: 2 x Rs 500/24h (Go2Andaman off-season rate, valid to 30 Sep)
events.notes: Booked >=48h ahead with DL copies; helmets included, fuel not.

events.title: Check in @ Bhuma Homestay
events.cost_note: Family room for 3, breakfast incl., CASH only
events.notes: 9.5/10-rated homestay 50 m from Govind Nagar Beach. Rs 5,000 refundable damage deposit.

events.title: Ride to Radhanagar (fuel en route)
events.notes: IndianOil pump sits ON the Radhanagar road — top both tanks.
events.tips: Scooter parking stand at the beach entrance, Rs 20-30.

events.title: Neil's Cove walk
events.notes: 1.2 km along the sand to the quiet lagoon — the crowd stays behind.

events.title: SUNSET @ Radhanagar Beach
events.notes: Sunset 17:14 (verified). Blue-Flag beach, lifeguards on duty.

events.title: Night ride back to Govind Nagar
events.notes: Dark by 17:36 — easy pace, high beam off for oncoming.

events.title: Dinner @ Something Different (beachside)
events.notes: 4.4-star beachside cafe, 400 m from Bhuma.

events.title: Market stroll + wind down
events.tips: Optional: call Andaman Bliss about a 03:30 biolum kayak (Rs 3,500 pp). Full-moon week = almost certainly no; Kala Pathar sunrise is the plan.

days.title: SUNRISE ROCKS → SHAHEED DWEEP
days.theme: Kala Pathar dawn, hop to Neil, high-tide watersports, Laxmanpur sunset.

events.title: Up in the dark
events.tips: Headlamp on, warm layer — pre-dawn ride.

events.title: SUNRISE @ Kala Pathar Beach
events.notes: Sunrise 05:09. Fallen trees + black rocks — the best-photo hour of the trip. Free roadside parking.

events.title: Breakfast @ Bhuma (incl.)
events.notes: Ask for it early the night before.

events.title: Ride to jetty, return scooters
events.notes: Jetty drop-off included in rental.

events.title: Green Ocean check-in
events.notes: Printed tickets again; counter closes 15 min before.

events.title: SAIL — Green Ocean 1 to Neil
events.notes: Cheapest of six verified Thursday sailings.

events.title: Neil scooters @ jetty
events.notes: Neil On Wheels, Neil Kendra (5.0-rated) — ph +91 94742 68205. Book ahead by phone.

events.title: Check in @ Blue Lagoon Resort
events.cost_note: King w/ balcony + breakfast, free cancellation
events.notes: 8.6/10; the sunrise beach is a 3-minute ride away.

events.title: Veg thali lunch @ Pure Veg Restaurant
events.notes: Neil's best-rated veg (4.8).

events.title: SNORKEL the coral garden (high tide)
events.notes: High tide 14:32 (verified) = the lagoon at its best. DiveIndia's Neil branch is 50 m away if anyone upgrades to a Rs ~4,500 intro dive.
events.tips: Book at the beach counter, never prepay online.

events.title: JET SKI runs
events.cost_note: 3 x Rs 800 (10-15 min each; verified range 800-1,200)
events.notes: Glassy high-tide water — the Goa comparison ends here.

events.title: Refuel @ Neil Kendra pump
events.notes: Neil's ONLY pump, practical hours ~07:00-18:00 — this is the last call.

events.title: SUNSET @ Laxmanpur
events.notes: Sunset 17:14. Dead-coral shore — watch, don't swim.

days.title: PINK DAWN → CLIFF RUN
days.theme: Sitapur sunrise, Natural Bridge at a 0.4 m low tide, ferry west, Munda Pahad trek, Chidiya Tapu sunset.

events.title: SUNRISE @ Sitapur Beach + cave & shipwreck
events.notes: Sunrise 05:09, pink-tinged sand. Walk ~500 m along the shore for the photo-frame cave and the shipwreck.

events.title: NATURAL BRIDGE at low tide
events.notes: Low tide 08:51 at 0.40 m (verified) — the full walk to and past the coral arch is open. Tide pools hold trapped fish.
events.tips: Grip water-shoes mandatory; dead coral is slippery. Optional guide Rs 500/group.

events.title: SAIL — Makruzz to Port Blair
events.notes: Chosen over the Rs 1,400 Green Ocean (arrives 12:45) for a 65-min margin on the Munda Pahad gate — the day's hard deadline.

events.title: PB scooters near jetty + snack grab
events.cost_note: 2 x ~Rs 600/day (Eternal Andamans; Rs 500 refundable deposit each)
events.notes: Eternal currently rents at Port Blair only — confirmed live. Grab bananas/snacks; lunch is light today.

events.title: Ride south to Chidiya Tapu
events.cost_note: ~2.7 L fuel for the 55 km round trip
events.notes: 24 km, 44 min on NH4 — South Andaman's prettiest road.

events.title: MUNDA PAHAD TREK
events.notes: Gate entry BEFORE 15:00 (we arrive 14:10 — 50-min margin). 1.3 km, ~30 min up; clifftop view that earns the Bali comparisons. Area clears by 16:00.

events.title: Munda Pahad beach + ride back to Chidiya Tapu
SUNSET @ Chidiya Tapu
events.notes: The best sunset stage in South Andaman (sunset 17:14). NO swimming — saltwater crocodiles are spotted here.
events.tips: Parking area is a short walk from the beach through tall trees.

events.title: Night ride back to Port Blair
Check in @ Hotel Atlanta (sea view)
events.notes: Location 9.3/10, opposite the Marina Park waterfront.

events.title: Dinner @ Annapurna Cafeteria
events.notes: Veg South-Indian stalwart, 200 m from the hotel.

events.title: Prep for Baratang + wind down
events.tips: Reconfirm the 04:00 cab, pack water/snacks/ID, keep cameras packed away for the convoy.

days.title: JARAWA CONVOY → LIMESTONE
days.theme: The 4 AM mission: convoy through the reserve, mangrove speedboat, million-year cave — then an earned nap and the Marina at dusk.

events.title: Cab to Jirkatang Check Post
events.cost_note: Private AC cab day-tour for 3 (verified range Rs 6,500-9,000 — lock price when booking)
events.notes: 47 km in the dark to make the 06:00 first convoy. Two-wheelers are banned past the check post.

events.title: CONVOY through the Jarawa reserve
events.notes: 48 km escorted. Absolutely no photography, no stopping, windows up if asked.
events.tips: You may glimpse Jarawa people — cameras stay down, it is a criminal offence.

events.title: Vehicle ferry across Middle Strait
events.notes: Fee included in cab tour.

events.title: Speedboat into the mangroves
events.notes: Creek channels narrow to a tunnel of roots — half the show is the ride.

events.title: LIMESTONE CAVES
events.notes: 1.2 km walk from the drop point, then ~35 min inside the sculpted chambers.
events.tips: Headlamp beats phone torch; floor is wet and uneven.

events.title: Early lunch @ Baratang jetty
events.notes: Simple veg meals only — eat now, the convoy won't stop.

events.title: Return convoy (12:30 slot)
events.notes: Convoy times south vary by source (12:00/12:30) — the driver knows the slot.

events.title: Earned nap
events.notes: Protects the sleep average after the 03:30 start.

events.title: Marina Park + Flag Point at dusk
events.notes: Where the first tricolour rose in 1943; the waterfront is 5 min from the hotel.

events.title: Optional: Cellular Jail light & sound
events.notes: Optional (~Rs 300 pp, not in budget); skip freely if tired — nothing downstream depends on it.

days.title: EXFIL
days.theme: Slow morning, 10:35 wheels-up, Chennai by lunch.

events.title: Breakfast + pack out
events.notes: Atlanta room rate has no breakfast — cafe next door or Annapurna (opens 07:00).

events.title: Cab to the airport
events.notes: 2.7 km against traffic — 10 min.

events.title: Check-in + security
events.notes: Akasa counter closes 09:50 — we're in with 1h45 to spare.

events.title: FLY — Akasa QP 1146 to Chennai
events.notes: 2h20m home. Right-side windows for a last look at the archipelago.

events.title: Land MAA — trip complete
events.notes: Every minute since Wednesday 03:45 is on this map.
